title: AAPS Extra statusline is broken
symptom: Every time xDrip receives that the loop is paused or currently waiting, it cuts the statusline in xDrip. The last characters are missing if 'loop deactivated' is shown.
cause: The statusline text length is limited to 40 characters, which is too short for the full statusline text.
fix: Increase the allowed text length from 40 to 70 characters. This was fixed in the February 20, 2024 release.
evidence_quote: Need to increase allowed text length from 40 to 70 to be sure.
